evals.prompt: Today we are working on the Tartarus UI. Find the right app, inspect the design system, and make a small dashboard polish change.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies web/ as the main Tartarus dashboard, reads web/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and relevant components, edits only the needed dashboard files, then runs a focused validation command.

evals.prompt: Add a new MCP tool to Tartarus and update the project memory afterwards.
evals.expected_output: The agent works in src/, checks existing MCP tool patterns, builds/tests the MCP server, and distinguishes journal entry updates from Entry 0 technical updates.

evals.prompt: The public website portfolio page needs a visual fix, not the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the task to website/, uses pnpm commands, preserves the separate public-site architecture, and avoids editing web/ unless a shared schema sync is required.
